entities.name: Query PalA/Rim20
observations: 768 aa fungal protein sequence; predicted molecular mass 86.8 kDa and theoretical pI 5.92.
Has a BRO1 domain at residues 5–382 and an ALIX_LYPXL_bnd domain at residues 418–719 by Pfam.
Shows strong homology to reviewed Aspergillus and Pyricularia PalA/Rim20 proteins; closest hit Q5KU05 has 99.7% identity over 100% query coverage.
Likely functions as a pH-response scaffold for proteolytic activation of PacC/Rim101, rather than as an enzyme.
C-terminal region contains proline/glutamine-rich low-complexity sequence consistent with disorder.

entities.name: PalA/Rim20
observations: Fungal pH-response regulator required for proteolytic cleavage of PacC or Rim101 during alkaline ambient-pH response.
Acts as a scaffold that recruits calpain-like PalB/Rim13 through Vps32 to the transcription-factor substrate.
Binds two YPX[LI] motifs in PacC/Rim101.
Associated with endosomes and/or the ESCRT-III complex in reviewed fungal annotations.

entities.name: BRO1 domain
observations: Detected in the query at residues 5–382 with Pfam i-Evalue 1e-126.
This N-terminal domain is characteristic of PalA/Rim20-family proteins and supports an ESCRT-associated scaffold role.

entities.name: ALIX LYPXL-binding domain
observations: Detected in the query at residues 418–719 with Pfam i-Evalue 2.3e-90.
Supports recognition of YPX[LI]/LYPXL-like motifs in interacting proteins.

entities.name: Fungal alkaline pH response
observations: PalA/Rim20 homologs mediate proteolytic activation of PacC/Rim101 transcription factors in response to alkaline ambient pH.
